description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to appoint Prof. Jayantha Walihinda to be the Competent Authority of Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute w.e.f. 27.08.2016
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Professor Jayantha Walihinda) and outlines detailed responsibilities and powers being assigned to him as Competent Authority of the Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute, including exercising powers in lieu of the Director and performing functions under the Universities Act and related regulations. This constitutes both a personnel appointment and detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Hybrid Gazette.
